title: Transactional Data: User Reviews of Government Mobile Applications
description: Transactional data on the user reviews of government mobile applications

fields.name: id
fields.title: Application ID
fields.description: [Integer] Unique identifier for each government mobile application; this can be matched against the app_id field in the main dataset.

fields.name: app_name
fields.title: Application Name
fields.description: [String] The official name of the government mobile application.

fields.name: app_os_platform
fields.title: Operating System Platform
fields.description: [Categorical] The OS platform on which the review was submitted: Android, iOS, or Huawei.

fields.name: review
fields.title: User Review
fields.description: [String] User-submitted review text for the application. May be empty if no review was provided.

fields.name: created_date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Timestamp] The timestamp when the review was submitted.

fields.name: star_rating
fields.title: Star Rating
fields.description: [Integer] The star rating given by the user, ranging from 1 to 5 stars. -1 indicates ratings without a star value.

methodology: Under the standards specified by the National Digital Department (JDN), all government mobile applications must be registered with the Malaysia Government Mobile Applications Gallery (GAMMA). This dataset represents an exact copy of the transactional data on user reviews stored in the GAMMA database.
caveat: The data represents applications tracked via the Malaysia Government Mobile Applications Gallery (GAMMA) only. As such, official applications not yet registered in GAMMA may be absent from this dataset.
